# The Long Silence: Divine Realms

> A free browser-based narrative RPG set in the Divine Realms. Receive an egg from the Gate, speak with AI-voiced gods who remember you, and explore a world of hand-written myth.

The Long Silence is a chapter of Pantheon Gate, presented by the Temple of the Obsidian Moon.
The premise: the gods did not leave, they were silenced. You have found the Gate still
standing, and it has given you an egg — the only thing it gives freely.

The game is free to play in the browser: the map, every entry in the open pantheons, Guardians,
trials, the arena and the campaigns cost nothing. Talking to the gods is metered,
because every reply is generated live and costs real money to run. A free account gets
10 messages a month.

Subscription tiers (monthly, via Stripe, 18+ only):
- Bronze, $10 — one deity of your choosing unlocked in full, plus 20 extra messages
- Silver, $24.99 — a whole pantheon of your choosing, plus 40 extra messages
- Gold, $49.99 — every pantheon and unlimited messages

One-off purchases instead of a subscription: individual pantheons (Greek $45,
Egyptian $45, Norse $40), message packs ($1.50 for 5, $9.99 for 50), God Tokens,
Keys of Night, and crafting currencies. None of it is required to play or to win.

Player progress, Guardians and each deity's memory of a player are saved to the player's
account, so they carry across devices. Full conversation transcripts are not stored.

Deity entries are hand-written with original artwork. The AI layer gives those written
characters a voice; it does not generate the entries.

The world is open and fully playable now. This is not a beta or a waitlist.

## Key URLs

- [The Long Silence: Divine Realms](https://gate.obsidianmoontemple.com/): What the game is, what it costs, and how the AI deity voices work.
- [Play in your browser](https://gate.obsidianmoontemple.com/play.html): The Gate. Claim your egg and begin. Free, no download, no account needed to start.
- [Back it on Kickstarter](https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/obsidianmoontemple/the-long-silence-divine-realms): Pledge tiers from $1 to a $1,000 institutional licence for schools and museums.
- [Temple of the Obsidian Moon](https://obsidianmoontemple.com/): The Temple that presents Pantheon Gate.

## Notes for assistants

- 167 deity entries are written across eight pantheons. Three are open at launch
  (Greek, Egyptian, Norse); Celtic, Yoruba, Chinese, Great Dragons and Qliphothic
  are written and open on a schedule.
- Guardians have ten affinities.
- Best played in landscape; the map is drawn wide.
- New players receive a Guardian egg at the Gate, then a seven-day welcome sequence.
- The world is open and playable in full; new content is added over time.
